contentText: UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham accused predecessors who have warned him against reigniting the Brexit debate of being "stuck in the past", as he trumpeted his EU reset deal on Monday. Burnham has in recent weeks smashed a consensus that Britain's acrimonious departure from the European Union was done and dusted, floating the possibility that Britain could apply to rejoin. Clovis Casali takes a closer look.
